description: Geometry of all municipalities (gemeenten), districts (wijken), and neighborhoods (buurten) in the Netherlands with statistical key figures (kerncijfers) as attributes. Contains demographic, household, and area statistics at three geographic levels. Updated annually by CBS (Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek / Statistics Netherlands). Boundaries derived from BRK (municipalities), municipality submissions (neighborhoods), and Bestand Bodemgebruik (water/land borders). Native CRS is EPSG:28992 (RD New / Amersfoort). Versions available for 2021-2025.

table:columns.name: gml_id
table:columns.description: Technical: feature id from the PDOK WFS GML output; not a CBS kerncijfer.

table:columns.name: buurtcode
table:columns.description: Neighborhood (buurt) code: 'BU' + 8 digits = 4-digit municipality + 2-digit district + 2-digit neighborhood number (e.g. BU00030102).

table:columns.name: buurtnaam
table:columns.description: Name of the neighborhood (buurt), the lowest regional level, delimited by the municipality and coordinated nationally by CBS.

table:columns.name: wijkcode
table:columns.description: District (wijk) code: 'WK' + 6 digits; first 4 digits are the municipality code. A wijk is part of a municipality comprising one or more buurten.

table:columns.name: gemeentecode
table:columns.description: Municipality (gemeente) code: 'GM' + 4 digits.

table:columns.name: gemeentenaam
table:columns.description: Name of the municipality (gemeente).

table:columns.name: indelingswijzigingWijkenEnBuurten
table:columns.description: Change vs previous year: 1 = code and boundary unchanged; 2 = code changed, boundary unchanged; 3 = boundary changed (figures not comparable).

table:columns.name: water
table:columns.description: Land/water flag: JA = polygon is (larger) water surface, NEE = land, B = Belgian territory (enclaves near Baarle-Nassau, municipality GM0998).

table:columns.name: meestVoorkomendePostcode
table:columns.description: Most common numeric (4-digit) postcode in the area, based on address counts in the Geographic Base Register (GBR) on 1 January.

table:columns.name: dekkingspercentage
table:columns.description: Share of addresses carrying the most common postcode, in six classes (1-6): >90%, 81-90%, 71-80%, 61-70%, 51-60%, <=50%.

table:columns.name: omgevingsadressendichtheid
table:columns.description: Environmental address density: average number of addresses per km2 within a 1 km radius around each address in the area, on 1 January.

table:columns.name: stedelijkheidAdressenPerKm2
table:columns.description: Urbanity class from address density: 1 very highly urban (>=2500 addr/km2), 2 (1500-2500), 3 (1000-1500), 4 (500-1000), 5 not urban (<500).

table:columns.name: bevolkingsdichtheidInwonersPerKm2
table:columns.description: Population density: inhabitants per km2 of land area.

table:columns.name: aantalInwoners
table:columns.description: Inhabitants registered in municipal population registers on 1 January; buurt/wijk figures are randomly rounded to multiples of 5.

table:columns.name: mannen
table:columns.description: Number of male inhabitants on 1 January.

table:columns.name: vrouwen
table:columns.description: Number of female inhabitants on 1 January.

table:columns.name: percentagePersonen0Tot15Jaar
table:columns.description: Inhabitants aged 0 up to 15 as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).

table:columns.name: percentagePersonen15Tot25Jaar
table:columns.description: Inhabitants aged 15 up to 25 as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).

table:columns.name: percentagePersonen25Tot45Jaar
table:columns.description: Inhabitants aged 25 up to 45 as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).

table:columns.name: percentagePersonen45Tot65Jaar
table:columns.description: Inhabitants aged 45 up to 65 as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).

table:columns.name: percentagePersonen65JaarEnOuder
table:columns.description: Inhabitants aged 65 and over as a percentage of total inhabitants (1 January).

table:columns.name: percentageOngehuwd
table:columns.description: Percentage of inhabitants never married and never in a registered partnership.

table:columns.name: percentageGehuwd
table:columns.description: Percentage married or in a registered partnership; includes persons legally separated (gescheiden van tafel en bed).

table:columns.name: percentageGescheid
table:columns.description: Percentage divorced from marriage or registered partnership; legally separated persons count as married.

table:columns.name: percentageVerweduwd
table:columns.description: Percentage widowed, including surviving partners of a registered partnership.

table:columns.name: aantalHuishoudens
table:columns.description: Number of private households on 1 January.

table:columns.name: percentageEenpersoonshuishoudens
table:columns.description: One-person households as a percentage of all private households.

table:columns.name: percentageHuishoudensZonderKinderen
table:columns.description: Multi-person households without children as a percentage of all private households.

table:columns.name: percentageHuishoudensMetKinderen
table:columns.description: Multi-person households with children as a percentage of all private households.

table:columns.name: gemiddeldeHuishoudsgrootte
table:columns.description: Average household size: persons in private households divided by the number of private households.

table:columns.name: percentageMetHerkomstlandNederland
table:columns.description: Percentage with country of origin Netherlands. Origin = own birth country; for NL-born persons, the parents' (mother's) birth country.

table:columns.name: percentageMetHerkomstlandUitEuropaExclNl
table:columns.description: Percentage with country of origin in Europe excl. NL (Turkey, Caucasus and Central Asia are counted under Asia).

table:columns.name: percentageMetHerkomstlandBuitenEuropa
table:columns.description: Percentage of inhabitants with country of origin outside Europe.

table:columns.name: percentageGebInNlMetHerkomstlandNederland
table:columns.description: Percentage born in the Netherlands with country of origin Netherlands.

table:columns.name: percGebInNlMetHerkomstlandInEuropaExNl
table:columns.description: Percentage born in the Netherlands with country of origin in Europe excl. the Netherlands.

table:columns.name: percGebInNlMetHerkomstlandBuitenEuropa
table:columns.description: Percentage born in the Netherlands with country of origin outside Europe.

table:columns.name: percGebBuitenNlMetHerkomstlndInEuropaExNl
table:columns.description: Percentage born outside the Netherlands with country of origin in Europe excl. the Netherlands.

table:columns.name: percGebBuitenNlMetHerkomstlndBuitenEuropa
table:columns.description: Percentage born outside the Netherlands with country of origin outside Europe.

table:columns.name: oppervlakteTotaalInHa
table:columns.description: Total area of the region in hectares (land plus water).

table:columns.name: oppervlakteLandInHa
table:columns.description: Land area of the region in hectares.

table:columns.name: oppervlakteWaterInHa
table:columns.description: Water area in hectares (inland and outer water; outer water is assigned only at municipality level).

table:columns.name: jrstatcode
table:columns.description: Technical key: reference year concatenated with the region code, e.g. '2025BU09989999' (CBS/PDOK file key).

table:columns.name: jaar
table:columns.description: Reference year of the Wijk- en Buurtkaart edition; most kerncijfers refer to 1 January of this year.

table:columns.name: fuuid
table:columns.description: Technical: PDOK feature UUID; not in the CBS documentation.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Technical: PC6 area polygon geometry (CBS source data in EPSG:28992 RD New); mirror geometry column, not a CBS statistical variable.

table:columns.name: geom_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float, ymin: float, xmax: float, ymax: float>
table:columns.description: Technical: per-feature bounding box struct added in the GeoParquet conversion for spatial indexing; not a CBS variable.

table:columns.name: wijknaam
table:columns.description: Name of the district (wijk) the neighborhood belongs to.
